question: How does Hebrews 7:9-10 say Levi paid the tenth to Melchizedek?
options: Through Abraham, because Levi was still in the body of his ancestor
By bringing it to the temple himself
explanation: Hebrews 7:9-10 says Levi paid the tenth through Abraham, because when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the body of his ancestor.
